package.name: rclpy_components
package.description:
Minimal local implementation of ros2/rclpy_components for ROS 2 Humble. Provides component_container_isolated executable that hosts rclpy plugins discovered via setuptools entry_points 'rclpy_components'.
This shim exists because the upstream ros2/rclpy_components is not available as an apt package for Humble (only Iron+) and the iron branch of ros2/rclpy does not contain the subdirectory in the layout expected by the build. By vendoring our own minimal implementation we eliminate the external dependency.
